Energy
Crusoe is an energy-first innovator

We leverage a diverse portfolio of energy resources. We prioritize underutilized resources and incentivize the development of new energy technologies that help us bend the arc of energy towards sustainability. The goal is to support the grid, not strain it, and to avoid shifting costs onto local ratepayers.

Water
Crusoe protects local water resources

Water is a shared resource and we treat it that way. Our data centers are designed from the ground up to minimize water use and keep local supplies secure for the people who depend on them.

Learn more
We use closed-loop, non-evaporative cooling systems that cool by recirculating water for up to 15 years after the initial fill.
We use high efficiency plumbing fixtures to minimize indoor water use.
We deploy intensive leak detection and monitoring in the system to minimize leaks and water loss.
We landscape with native plants and no permanent irrigation to minimize outdoor water use.*
*Unless jurisdictions have special requirements.
